subject: Aids to Navigation - Vancouver Harbour
text:
Aids to Navigation - Vancouver Harbour
Berry Point Sector Light LL 411.4 established in Vancouver Harbour at 49 17.762N 122 59.166W.
The light is fixed green at 087.9 degrees, oscillating green-white at 087.4, fixed white from 087.1 to 086.8, oscillating white-red at 086.5 and fixed red at 086.0 degrees.
The light has a nominal range of 8.97NM.
